author: Kim Holzer
text: We had our first fertilization consultation with Greenup Lawn and Sprinklers, and I was very impressed. They were professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to answer all of my questions. The team was punctual, courteous, and explained everything clearly without any pressure. It was obvious they care about doing quality work and helping customers make the best decisions for their lawn, fertilizer and sprinkler needs. Great first experience, and we are looking forward to working with them!

author: Executive Director
text: What an amazing company!  They donated items to the children's museum that helped make out Great Indoors Exhibit feel like a real campsite!  It is companies like this that make our community great!!!

author: Noel Yelvington
text: We’ve been using this company for a few years for lawn treatments and they always do such a great job. Our lawn always looks great. Everyone we have interacted with is so kind. Their customer service is very responsive. I highly recommend this company.

author: Rebecca
text: Greenup was easy to communicate with, provided a good quote and price, and the employee who did the pest control spray was polite and professional. My only concern was how the pest control spray was administered inside the house, seemingly in places it shouldn’t have been applied, but I am expecting a call back from Greenup to help me understand their process.

author: Annabelle Pratt
text: My father called because he was looking for some services that weren’t listed on the website. He was greeted by Casey, who was either unable or unwilling to answer his questions. Every time he asked something, she would immediately interrupt and ask for his name, address, and phone number so someone could call him back. I understand that’s sometimes the process, but the interaction was short and unfriendly, and he ended the call with no other information, feeling completely dismissed. He ended up calling another company instead. First impressions matter!
